panels.title: Total Registered Users
panels.description: Current number of users in the database (polled from DB on each /metrics scrape).

panels.title: Total Todos (all)
panels.description: Total todo items across all users in the database.

panels.title: Active (Incomplete) Todos
panels.description: Todos with completed=false currently in the database.

panels.title: Completed Todos
panels.description: Todos with completed=true currently in the database.

panels.title: Users With Todos
panels.description: Distinct users who own at least one todo item.

panels.title: Todo Completion Rate
panels.description: Percentage of all todos that are marked completed.

panels.title: User Growth — Registrations over Time
panels.description: Total registered users gauge over time, showing user growth trend.

panels.title: Todo Inventory — Total / Active / Completed over Time
panels.description: Database state over time: total, active, and completed todos.

panels.title: Registration & Login Rate (events/min)
panels.description: Rate of registration events and successful/failed logins per second.

panels.title: Todo Activity Rate (events/min)
panels.description: Rate of todo create, update, and delete events.

panels.title: Token Validation — Valid vs Invalid
panels.description: Rate of valid and invalid token validations. Spike in 'invalid' may indicate token expiry, logout, or an attack.

panels.title: Failed Logins (all time)
panels.description: Cumulative failed login count. Monitor for brute-force spikes.

panels.title: VPA - todo-service Update Mode
panels.description: VPA is set to 'Off' (recommendation-only). It will NOT auto-resize pods — use the recommendations manually.

panels.title: VPA CPU Target Recommendation
panels.description: VPA recommended CPU target for todo-service containers. Compare against current resource requests.

panels.title: VPA Memory Target Recommendation
panels.description: VPA recommended memory target for todo-service containers. Compare against current resource requests.

panels.title: Current CPU Request (todo-service)
panels.description: Actual CPU request currently set on todo-service containers. Compare with VPA recommendation.

panels.title: VPA CPU Recommendation vs Actual Usage - todo-service
panels.description: Shows VPA target/lower/upper CPU recommendations alongside actual container CPU usage. Since updateMode is Off, these are advisory values only.

panels.title: VPA Memory Recommendation vs Actual Usage - todo-service
panels.description: Shows VPA target/lower/upper memory recommendations alongside actual container memory. Since updateMode is Off, these are advisory values only.

panels.title: VPA Uncapped CPU Target - todo-service
panels.description: Uncapped target is what VPA would recommend ignoring resource limit/request constraints. Useful to see the 'true' recommended value before policy capping.

panels.title: VPA Uncapped Memory Target - todo-service
panels.description: Uncapped memory target vs capped target. A large gap indicates LimitRange or VPA policy is constraining the recommendation.

panels.title: VPA Recommendations Snapshot - todo-service
panels.description: Point-in-time snapshot of all VPA recommendation values. Use this to decide when to update Deployment resource requests manually.

panels.title: Auth Service — Login & Registration Events
panels.description: Filter auth-service logs for login/register keywords.

panels.title: Todo Service — Create / Update / Delete Events
panels.description: Filter todo-service logs for CRUD operation keywords.
